newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Commerce Asset sells leasing unit.
newsitem.headline: Commerce Asset sells leasing unit.

text.p: Commerce Asset-Holding Bhd said it was selling its entire equity interest in wholly-owned subsidiary Commerce Asset Leasing Sdn Bhd (CAL) to Austral Amalgamated Bhd for 5.23 million ringgit.
The consideration would be paid for in cash, the companies said in separate statements late on Wednesday.
Commerce Asset said CAL, whose principal activity was lease financing, had a paid-up capital of 2.0 million ringgit.
The disposal was arrived at on a willing-seller willing-buyer basis, the company said.
Austral said the purchase presented it a "timely opportunity" to capitalise on the profitability of the finance sector.
